subject: maths

concepts.title: Finding Percentage Part from Total
concepts.definition: Determining the specific numerical portion corresponding to a given percentage of a whole quantity.
concepts.key_idea: Multiply the total quantity by the given percentage rate expressed as a fraction.
question_patterns: find {percentage} percent of {total}
calculate the value corresponding to {percentage}% of {total}
what is {percentage} percent of {total}
how much is {percentage}% out of {total}
determine the part when {percentage}% of {total} is taken

solution_steps.action: calculate the specified fractional part of the total
solution_steps.explain: multiply total by percentage divided by 100

concepts.title: Finding Total Quantity from Percentage Part
concepts.definition: Calculating the total amount when a specific percentage and its corresponding value are known.
concepts.key_idea: Divide the given value by its percentage rate to determine the whole quantity.
question_patterns: if {percentage}% of a quantity is {part}, find the total quantity
calculate the total number when {percentage} percent equals {part}
what is the total amount if {part} represents {percentage}%
how much was the total if {percentage}% of it is {part}
determine the full value given that {percentage}% is {part}

solution_steps.action: compute total quantity using the unitary method formula
solution_steps.explain: divide the part value by percentage rate and multiply by 100

concepts.title: Ratio Comparison and Percentage Conversion
concepts.definition: Expressing two quantities as a ratio in simplest form or converting a given ratio to a percentage.
concepts.key_idea: Ratios compare quantities of same units and convert to percentages when multiplied by 100.
question_patterns: find the ratio of {a} to {b}
convert the ratio {a}:{b} to a percentage
calculate the ratio comparing {a} and {b}
what is the percentage equivalent of ratio {a} to {b}
express {a} to {b} as a simplified ratio

solution_steps.action: convert quantities to identical units
solution_steps.explain: ensure both quantities are in the same measurement units before comparison

solution_steps.action: simplify fraction or multiply by 100 for percentage
solution_steps.explain: divide numerator and denominator by common factors or convert ratio to percent

concepts.title: Discount Amount and Sale Price
concepts.definition: Calculating the reduction in marked price and the final cost payable by a buyer after discount.
concepts.key_idea: Discount is calculated as a percentage of marked price and subtracted to get sale price.
question_patterns: find the sale price of an item marked at {marked_price} with a discount of {discount_percent}%
calculate the final price after a discount of {discount_percent} percent on {marked_price}
what is the sale price if list price is {marked_price} and discount is {discount_percent}%
how much will a customer pay for an article marked {marked_price} at {discount_percent}% off
determine the reduction and sale price for marked price {marked_price} and discount rate {discount_percent}%

solution_steps.action: calculate the discount amount
solution_steps.explain: multiply marked price by discount percent divided by 100

solution_steps.action: subtract discount from marked price to get sale price
solution_steps.explain: sale price equals marked price minus discount amount

concepts.title: Discount Percentage
concepts.definition: Determining the rate of discount expressed as a percentage relative to the original marked price.
concepts.key_idea: The discount percentage is the ratio of discount amount to marked price, multiplied by 100.
question_patterns: an item marked at {marked_price} is sold for {sale_price}, find the discount percentage
calculate the discount percent when marked price is {marked_price} and sale price is {sale_price}
what is the rate of discount if MP is {marked_price} and SP is {sale_price}
how much percent discount is offered if list price is {marked_price} and selling price is {sale_price}
determine discount rate given marked price {marked_price} and sale price {sale_price}

solution_steps.action: find discount amount
solution_steps.explain: subtract sale price from marked price

solution_steps.action: calculate percentage of discount on marked price
solution_steps.explain: divide discount by marked price and multiply by 100

concepts.title: Marked Price from Sale Price and Discount Percentage
concepts.definition: Reconstructing the original marked price when the reduced sale price and percentage discount are provided.
concepts.key_idea: Sale price represents (100 - discount_percent)% of the marked price.
question_patterns: find the marked price if sale price is {sale_price} after a discount of {discount_percent}%
calculate marked price given selling price {sale_price} and discount rate {discount_percent} percent
what was the list price if an item is sold for {sale_price} with {discount_percent}% discount
how much was the original price when customer paid {sale_price} after {discount_percent}% discount
determine original marked price for SP {sale_price} at {discount_percent}% off

solution_steps.action: compute percentage factor of sale price relative to marked price
solution_steps.explain: subtract discount percentage from 100

solution_steps.action: calculate original marked price
solution_steps.explain: divide sale price by price factor and multiply by 100

concepts.title: Bill Amount with Sales Tax or GST
concepts.section: 7.3 Sales Tax/Value Added Tax/Goods and Services Tax
concepts.definition: Calculating the total bill payable after adding the specified tax percentage to the base price of an article.
concepts.key_idea: Tax is an additional charge calculated as a percentage of the selling price and added to it.
question_patterns: the cost of an item is {cost_price} and tax rate is {tax_rate}%, find the bill amount
calculate total payable amount for cost {cost_price} with sales tax of {tax_rate} percent
what is the bill amount when item costs {cost_price} plus {tax_rate}% GST
how much does a buyer pay for article costing {cost_price} subject to {tax_rate}% VAT
determine total cost including tax for item priced at {cost_price} with tax {tax_rate}%

solution_steps.action: compute tax amount
solution_steps.explain: multiply cost price by tax rate divided by 100

solution_steps.action: add tax amount to cost price to find total bill
solution_steps.explain: bill amount equals original cost plus tax

concepts.title: Price Before Tax (VAT or GST)
concepts.section: 7.3 Sales Tax/Value Added Tax/Goods and Services Tax
concepts.definition: Computing the original price of an item prior to the inclusion of sales tax, VAT, or GST.
concepts.key_idea: Total price including tax corresponds to (100 + tax_rate)% of original price.
question_patterns: an article was bought for {total_price} including {tax_rate}% tax, find original price before tax
calculate price before tax when total price with {tax_rate}% GST is {total_price}
what was the price before VAT if cooler was bought for {total_price} including {tax_rate}% VAT
how much was original cost when item was purchased for {total_price} with {tax_rate}% tax included
determine initial price prior to tax for total bill of {total_price} at tax rate {tax_rate}%

solution_steps.action: calculate total percentage factor including tax
solution_steps.explain: add tax rate to 100

solution_steps.action: compute price before tax
solution_steps.explain: divide total price by tax factor and multiply by 100

concepts.title: Simple Interest and Total Amount
concepts.definition: Calculating the fixed interest earned on a principal over time and the total accumulated sum.
concepts.key_idea: Simple interest is calculated on the original principal throughout the term.
question_patterns: find simple interest and amount on sum {principal} at {rate}% per annum for {time} years
calculate total amount payable on sum {principal} borrowed at rate {rate}% for {time} years
what is the simple interest for principal {principal} at interest rate {rate}% over {time} years
how much interest is charged on {principal} at {rate}% per year for {time} years
determine amount and simple interest given principal {principal}, rate {rate}%, and time {time} years

solution_steps.action: compute simple interest
solution_steps.explain: multiply principal by rate and time, then divide by 100

solution_steps.action: add simple interest to principal to find total amount
solution_steps.explain: amount equals principal plus simple interest

concepts.title: Compound Interest and Final Amount
concepts.section: 7.5 Deducing a Formula for Compound Interest
concepts.definition: Calculating the total amount and compound interest accumulated when interest is compounded annually.
concepts.key_idea: Interest earned each period is added to principal for calculating subsequent interest.
question_patterns: find compound interest on {principal} for {time} years at {rate}% per annum compounded annually
calculate total amount for sum {principal} at rate {rate}% compounded annually for {time} years
what is the CI on sum {principal} at {rate}% p.a. for {time} years
how much compound interest accumulates on {principal} at rate {rate}% over {time} years
determine final amount and CI for principal {principal}, rate {rate}%, time {time} years

solution_steps.action: compute accumulated amount using compound interest formula
solution_steps.explain: apply A = P*(1 + R/100)^n formula

solution_steps.action: calculate compound interest
solution_steps.explain: subtract principal from total accumulated amount

concepts.title: Compound Growth and Population Increase
concepts.definition: Determining the increased population or quantity after a fixed period at a constant annual compound growth rate.
concepts.key_idea: Growth applied to population or count compounds annually using the compound interest formula structure.
question_patterns: the population was {initial_value} and grew at {growth_rate}% p.a., find population after {time} years
calculate growth of bacteria starting at {initial_value} increasing at rate {growth_rate}% per hour for {time} hours
what will be the population after {time} years if current population is {initial_value} with growth rate {growth_rate}%
how much does quantity increase from {initial_value} at {growth_rate}% compound rate in {time} years
determine future value for initial count {initial_value} with compounding growth rate {growth_rate}% over {time} units

solution_steps.action: calculate future value using compound growth formula
solution_steps.explain: multiply initial value by (1 + growth_rate/100) raised to time

concepts.title: Depreciation of Asset Value
concepts.definition: Evaluating the reduced monetary value of an item after accounting for annual percentage depreciation.
concepts.key_idea: Depreciation reduces value periodically by applying negative compound growth rate.
question_patterns: a machine bought at {initial_price} depreciates by {depreciation_rate}%, find value after {time} year
calculate depreciated value of vehicle bought for {initial_price} at rate {depreciation_rate}% after {time} years
what is the value of TV bought for {initial_price} after depreciating {depreciation_rate}% in {time} year
how much is an article worth if initial price is {initial_price} and depreciation rate is {depreciation_rate}% over {time} years
determine final reduced price for item costing {initial_price} with annual depreciation {depreciation_rate}% for {time} years

solution_steps.action: calculate depreciated value using decay formula
solution_steps.explain: multiply initial price by (1 - depreciation_rate/100) raised to time
